A Partial state in field 6 requires field 12. Name a person, not a role; if nobody owns a layer, write UNOWNED in field 8 and fill its gap owner and decision date. An Absent layer still needs the artefact that would prove it exists. Use the glossary strip first; fill the two cross-cutting bands and audit panel, then close the audit probe as Pass or Fail.
